description: PART 1 / the 'B option': add a separate Portfolio page (portfolio.html + js/pages/portfolio.js) distinct from the Wallet, and slim the Wallet (dashboard.html) down. This is self-contained, low risk, and adds NO new API endpoint - it reuses api.me() (wallet object) and api.snapshot(). Independent of FEAT-003/004/005; can be reviewed on its own. Do the design changes with existing css/core.css classes and reveal animations only.
steps:
Add a Portfolio nav link. In js/ui.js edit the NAV array (~line 142) to insert { href: 'portfolio.html', label: 'Portfolio', auth: true } immediately AFTER the Wallet entry ({ href: 'dashboard.html', label: 'Wallet', auth: true }). Also add a matching footer link in the account list (~line 241, next to the existing dashboard.html 'Wallet'
  • ): '
  • Portfolio
    • '.

Create portfolio.html by copying the head/nav/footer scaffolding and CDN includes from dashboard.html (same fonts, css/core.css, arv-config.js, lightweight-charts 4.2.3 defer,
,
, , title 'Portfolio — ARV Coin', meta robots noindex). Build these sections using existing classes (card, card-tight, stat, stat-v, chip, grid g-4, split, stack, chart-shell, ledger-list/ledger-row, wallet-split): (a) a hero 'Total portfolio value' = cash (wallet.inrPaise + inrLockedPaise) + current ARV holding value (wallet.valuePaise), with data-* hooks; (b) a cash-vs-ARV allocation split showing rupee balance vs ARV value and each side's percentage of the total; (c) a performance chart (chart-shell + data-chart + data-range-tabs) with the user's average-cost price line (wallet.avgCostNav), mirroring the chart wiring in js/pages/dashboard.js loadChart(); (d) P&L cards in a grid g-4: Invested (wallet.investedPaise at wallet.avgCostNav average), Unrealised (wallet.unrealisedPaise + wallet.unrealisedPct), Realised (wallet.realisedPaise), and Exit-after-tax (the net 'balance at filing' style figure); (e) the existing 'If you sold everything now' exit breakdown block (data-whatif) moved/duplicated from dashboard.html.

Create js/pages/portfolio.js modeled on js/pages/dashboard.js. Reuse: ui.boot({feed:false}), api.requireUser(), api.me(true) for the wallet, api.snapshot() for nav/stats. Implement paintPortfolio() (hero total, allocation split, P&L cards), the chart via api.candles(range.tf, range.days, CFG.CHARTS.maxCandles) with the avg-cost price line exactly as dashboard.js does, and paintWhatIf() via api.quoteSell(units) exactly as dashboard.js does. Poll api.snapshot()+api.me(true) every 30s like dashboard.js. Do NOT add any new api.js function or new PHP endpoint - everything needed is already on the wallet object (inrPaise, inrLockedPaise, arvUnits, arvLockedUnits, arvTotalUnits, valuePaise, investedPaise, avgCostNav, unrealisedPaise, unrealisedPct, realisedPaise) and api.snapshot().

Slim dashboard.html (Wallet): remove the P&L grid g-4 (ARV price / Invested / Unrealised / Realised cards) and the 'If you sold everything now' (data-whatif) block, since those now live on portfolio.html. Keep: greeting, gate notices, the wallet-split (rupee balance + ARV holding with quick Deposit/Withdraw/Buy/Sell actions), open orders, recent activity, and the market watchlist. Add a small link/CTA pointing to portfolio.html for the full portfolio view. Keep the chart on the Wallet OR move it to portfolio only - prefer keeping a compact chart on Wallet but the detailed performance chart with P&L belongs on Portfolio; if removing the chart from Wallet, also remove the now-unused chart code paths from js/pages/dashboard.js.

Update js/pages/dashboard.js to match the slimmed dashboard.html: remove paintWhatIf() and the P&L card painting that reference removed DOM (or guard them so removed selectors are no-ops). Ensure no JS error is thrown when the removed elements are absent (the existing ui.el/ui.setText helpers already no-op on missing nodes, but paintWhatIf returns early only when [data-whatif] is missing - verify each removed block is guarded).
acceptance_criteria: js/ui.js NAV array contains a Portfolio entry (href portfolio.html, auth:true) positioned immediately after the Wallet entry, and the footer account list contains a Portfolio link.
portfolio.html exists and references js/pages/portfolio.js, arv-config.js, css/core.css and the lightweight-charts CDN, using only existing CSS classes.
js/pages/portfolio.js exists, calls api.requireUser()/api.me(true)/api.snapshot()/api.candles()/api.quoteSell() and adds NO new api.js export and NO new PHP endpoint.

portfolio.html renders: total portfolio value (cash + ARV value), cash-vs-ARV allocation split, a performance chart with the avg-cost line, P&L cards (Invested, Unrealised, Realised, Exit-after-tax), and the 'if you sold everything now' breakdown.

dashboard.html no longer contains the duplicated full P&L framing / whatif block and focuses on cash + units + quick actions + orders + activity, and js/pages/dashboard.js does not reference removed DOM in a way that throws.
verification: Run `node --check js/pages/portfolio.js && node --check js/pages/dashboard.js && node --check js/ui.js` and confirm no parse errors.

Grep to confirm the wiring: `grep -n "portfolio.html" js/ui.js` shows the nav and footer links; `grep -n "data-whatif\|grid g-4" dashboard.html` shows the P&L/whatif blocks were removed from the Wallet.

Confirm portfolio.js adds no new endpoint: `grep -n "request(" js/pages/portfolio.js` should only be indirect via api.* calls (portfolio.js should not call api.request directly), and `git diff js/api.js api/` shows no new market/account actions were added for this feature.
findings: Added Portfolio nav link in js/ui.js NAV array (after Wallet) and footer account list. Created portfolio.html (copied dashboard.html scaffolding: fonts, css/core.css, arv-config.js, lightweight-charts 4.2.3 defer, data-nav/data-footer, module script, title 'Portfolio — ARV Coin', noindex) with: hero total = cash(inrPaise+inrLockedPaise)+valuePaise; cash-vs-ARV allocation split with per-side pct chips; performance chart (chart-shell + data-chart + data-range-tabs) with avg-cost price line; P&L grid g-4 (Invested/Unrealised/Realised/Exit-after-tax); and the 'If you sold everything now' data-whatif block. Created js/pages/portfolio.js modeled on dashboard.js: ui.boot({feed:false}), api.requireUser(), api.me(true), api.snapshot(), chart via api.candles(range.tf,range.days,CFG.CHARTS.maxCandles) with the same avg-cost createPriceLine + same chart structure so FEAT-003 live-tick wiring can be added uniformly, paintWhatIf() via api.quoteSell() (also fills the Exit-after-tax card from q.balanceTaxPaise), and a 30s api.snapshot()+api.me(true) poll. Added NO new api.js export and NO new PHP endpoint (git diff of js/api.js and api/ is empty; portfolio.js makes no direct api.request call). Slimmed dashboard.html: removed the P&L grid g-4 and the data-whatif block, replaced with a compact 'View full portfolio' CTA card linking portfolio.html; kept greeting/gate notices/wallet-split/compact chart/open orders/activity/watchlist/referral. Updated js/pages/dashboard.js: removed paintWhatIf() and the P&L card painting (data-price/data-change/data-invested/data-avg-cost/data-unrealised/data-unrealised-pct/data-realised) and dropped the now-unused nav var and both paintWhatIf call sites, so no removed DOM is referenced. Verification: `node --check` (run with `env -u NODE_OPTIONS`) passed on js/pages/portfolio.js, js/pages/dashboard.js and js/ui.js; grep confirms portfolio.html links in ui.js nav+footer, no data-whatif/grid g-4 left in dashboard.html, no direct request( in portfolio.js, and git diff shows no changes under js/api.js or api/. No PHP files changed. Runtime (DB/exchange feed) not exercisable in sandbox per context.json; chart/whatif behaviour deferred to a live environment.
